diagram_previews.alt: A non-convex hexagon D A E B F C: an inner triangle DEF with three thin triangular spikes ADE, BEF and CFD attached to its sides; the sides DE, EF and FD of the inner triangle are drawn dashed in blue as the interior diagonals.

difficulty_rationale: The lower bound needs the existence of an interior diagonal (an extremal-vertex argument) and an induction on triangulations; the matching example needs a deliberately non-convex construction.
